question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R sits third to the left of Q. P sits second to the left of T. Both U and P are immediate neighbours of Q. V is not an immediate neighbour of R. How many people sit between T and U when counted from the left of T?
solution:
**Given: **P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

R sits third to the left of Q. P sits second to the left of T.

Both U and P are immediate neighbours of Q. V is not an immediate neighbour of R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c93a150d2bb3062817e20cb4ded0d6dc51d6653827eb413691ec2440214737.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4b9a90d09c8c8171a0f4552c87bfcb4ff732f6804055ae0680779eb9973b114.png] 

Thus, Only 3 people sit between T and U when counted from the left of T

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 2".**
